mapper.select: SELECT FROM sale_order s WHERE s.request_key=#{requestKey}
SELECT FROM sale_order s WHERE s.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM sale_order s WHERE s.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

sql.where: AND (CONVERT(s.order_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sale_item k WHERE k.sale_id=s.id AND (k.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(k.product_code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(k.product_barcode USING utf8mb4)=#{query.keyword})))AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sale_item k WHERE k.sale_id=s.id AND k.product_id=#{query.productId})AND s.cashier_id=#{query.cashierId}AND s.status=#{query.status}AND s.payment_method=#{query.paymentMethod}AND s.completed_at>=#{query.startDate} AND s.completed_at<DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,s.order_no,CAST(s.cashier_id AS CHAR) cashier_id,s.cashier_name,s.status,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_item i WHERE i.sale_id=s.id) item_count,s.total_qty,s.total_amount,s.payment_method,s.received_amount,s.change_amount,s.completed_at,s.corrected_at,s.row_version FROM sale_order s ORDER BY s.completed_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount),0) original_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='COMPLETED' THEN s.total_amount ELSE 0 END),0) net_amount,COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) completed_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status='CORRECTED' THEN 1 END) corrected_count FROM sale_order s

SELECT id,sale_id,line_no,product_id,product_code,product_barcode,product_name,category_id,category_name,specification,unit,unit_price,quantity,line_amount FROM sale_item WHERE sale_id=#{saleId} ORDER BY line_no
SELECT a.id,a.sale_item_id,a.product_id,a.batch_item_id,a.quantity FROM sale_allocation a JOIN sale_item i ON i.id=a.sale_item_id WHERE i.sale_id=#{saleId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT p.id,p.code,p.name,p.unit,p.sale_price,p.enabled,p.can_sell,p.frozen_stocktake_id IS NOT NULL frozen,COALESCE(b.qty,0) saleable_qty FROM product p LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.product_id,SUM(i.stock_qty) qty FROM purchase_item i JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=i.purchase_id WHERE o.status='IN_STOCK' AND i.batch_no IS NOT NULL AND i.stock_qty>0 AND (i.manages_expiry=0 OR i.expiry_date>=#{today}) GROUP BY i.product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id WHERE p.id IN #{id}
